transcript: I am not exaggerating when I say I think this might be my favorite play I've seen all year. And I don't want to give away too much, but people, places and things tells the story of an actress who is an addict and going through the process of recovery. And a large part of what makes this play so exceptional is the central performance by Denise Goff. She's on stage basically the entire play, and the transformation that she goes through throughout the show is just so expertly done. Goth is able to perfectly thread this needle of it's a character that you want to root for and you're sympathetic for, but the same time, like, as an addict, there's a lot of not great things that she does throughout the show. I honestly have not felt this way watching a performance since I saw Jodie Comer in prima facie. And I really do think that this is going to go down as, like, one of my all time favorite stage performances. I was completely transfixed by her the entire time, from start to finish. And then you have the entire production around her, which is equally masterful. We have a set by Bunny Christie, who is one of my favorite designers working today. She just did the recent company revival on Broadway and in the West End, and also the current immersive guys and dolls revival, which I may or may not be seeing later, but she is quickly Become one of my favorite designers for how innovative she is, and this set is certainly no exception. The staging and direction is by Jeremy Heron, who also deserves a lot of credit here. The entire production is just incredibly engrossing and brings you into our main character's headspace, and that is perfectly achieved by Jeremy. Slick and kinetic direction. This production has been around since I think 2016, and it is so clear to me why they keep bringing it back. It's not only an incredibly solid play, but the central performance and overall staging make it a must see. And for me, this is a very easy 5 stars. Huge recommendation for me. It is running on the West End through August 10th, so you don't have a ton of time left to catch it, but if you do make it, you will not regret it.
